reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering artisan goods, explosives, crops, relationship and mining items, fish, milk, seeds, and monster musk were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary and fish names, gameplay effects, crop timing, object gender, item humor, and imperative wording; both found no remaining objective issue.

Mead_Description.source: A fermented beverage made from honey. Drink in moderation.
Mead_Description.translation: O băutură fermentată din miere. A se consuma cu moderație.

MegaBomb_Description.source: Generates a powerful explosion. Use with extreme caution.
MegaBomb_Description.translation: Provoacă o explozie puternică. Folosește-o cu extremă precauție.

Melon_Description.translation: Un deliciu răcoritor și dulce de vară.

MelonSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 12 days to mature.
MelonSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le vara. Ajung la maturitate în 12 zile.

MermaidsPendant_Description.source: Give this to the person you want to marry.
MermaidsPendant_Description.translation: Dăruiește-l persoanei cu care vrei să te căsătorești.

MidnightCarp_Description.source: This shy fish only feels comfortable at night.
MidnightCarp_Description.translation: Acest pește timid se simte în largul lui doar noaptea.

MidnightSquid_Description.source: A strange and mysterious denizen of the ocean's twilight depths.
MidnightSquid_Description.translation: Un locuitor straniu și misterios al adâncurilor întunecate ale oceanului.

Milk_Description.translation: Un bidon cu lapte de vacă.

MinersTreat_Description.source: This should keep your energy up.

MixedFlowerSeeds_Description.source: An assortment of flower seeds. Plant them and see what grows!
MixedFlowerSeeds_Description.translation: Un amestec de semințe de flori. Plantează-le și vezi ce răsare!

MixedSeeds_Description.source: There's a little bit of everything here. Plant them and see what grows!
MixedSeeds_Description.translation: Aici găsești câte puțin din toate. Plantează-le și vezi ce răsare!

MonsterMusk_Description.source: Spray this on to draw more monsters out of hiding.
MonsterMusk_Description.translation: Pulverizează-l asupra ta pentru a atrage mai mulți monștri din ascunzători.
